name: banking-latefusion-architecture-smoke
split_policy: Inherit original frozen source-task lineage splits; 2 train / 1 validation / 1 engineering test groups. All groups remain excluded from formal testing.
supervision: S (session attempt labels); window labels inherited from sessions, not event-level truth
T_encoder: Fixed sklearn HashingVectorizer character 3-5 grams, 4096 dimensions, alternate_sign=false, L2 normalization; lexical smoke adaptation, not a pretrained semantic encoder
fit_policy: Train-only heads, count vocabularies and scalers; each session has equal total training weight
aggregation: Maximum window decision score per modality and session
length_correction: One stratum (smoke-only; train-derived window count ranges recorded), benign validation centering and unit scale if variance is zero; multi-stratum correction unsupported at this sample size
fusion_candidates: nonnegative simplex weights in steps of 0.25
selection: Validation F1, then lower validation FPR, then first declared fusion rule; threshold uses >=
low_FPR: 95th higher benign-validation quantile; strict > comparator; achieved FPR reported, no 5% guarantee
probability_mapping: Two-parameter regularized logistic mapping fitted only to both validation classes
test_policy: Freeze and reload every model, fusion rule and threshold before opening any test representation. Test labels are joined only after all frozen predictions exist.
robustness: Development validation only: level-2 TEN uniform event drop 5/10/20 percent and first 25/50/75 percent prefixes; fixed seed and frozen thresholds. No performance claims.
unsupported: exact first-harm time and online warning
